name: Quick Audio Visualizer
description: Turn music into editable Blender animation. Make objects, lights and materials react to frequencies, beats and custom audio ranges.
schemaDescription: Blender audio visualizer add-on for audio-reactive object, light and material animation with editable keyframes.

name: Quick Birds & Insects
description: Create animated bird flocks and insect swarms with 17 flying variants, eight editable flight paths and flexible formations.
schemaDescription: Blender flock and swarm add-on with 17 bird, bat and insect variants and editable flight paths.

name: Quick Garden Billboards
description: Add lightweight garden plants made from original photography. Browse the library, vary assets and face billboards toward the camera.
schemaDescription: Blender plant library add-on with original garden photography and lightweight camera-facing billboards.

name: Stylized Water Pro
description: Create animated stylized water with a procedural shader, Geometry Nodes waves, foam, ripples, floating objects and presets.
schemaDescription: Blender stylized water add-on with procedural shading, Geometry Nodes waves, foam, ripples and floating object controls.
